metadata.title: Polynomial multipliers of differentiation-hypercyclic functions
metadata.description:
We give a self-contained elementary negative answer to Costakis's2008 pointwise polynomial-multiplier question. A dense family of differentiation-hypercyclic entire functions f has |(pf)^(n)(0)| tending to infinity for every nonconstant complex polynomial p, simultaneously for each f. The proof uses relative Baire category in spaces of derivative-normalized Taylor jets with eventual annular bounds. Universal polynomial multipliers preserving the full hypercyclic class are exactly the nonzero constants.

This is an attributed historical-answer and alternative-proof note, without a claim of a new first solution or first existence theorem. Nikula's earlier random-function theorem already implies a stronger frequently hypercyclic version by Gaussian small-ball/tail estimates; an earlier Bayart-Matheron Gaussian-eigenfield route is also credited. The exact multiplier corollary's first explicit recording and earliest underpinning remain undetermined. The deposit includes the preprint and a portable TeX-source, exact-verification, independent-reconstruction and bounded-priority-audit archive. AI tools were used extensively in research, proof development, literature review, computation, internal adversarial verification and writing. This preprint is unrefereed; no external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed.
